functions.name: IsVelocityUnderSimulationThreshold
functions.docs: Returns true if velocity magnitude is less than BounceVelocityStopSimulatingThreshold.

functions.name: SetVelocityInLocalSpace
functions.docs: Sets the velocity to the new value, rotated into Actor space.

functions.name: StopSimulating
functions.docs: Clears the reference to UpdatedComponent, fires stop event (OnProjectileStop), and stops ticking (if bAutoUpdateTickRegistration is true).

functions.name: SetInterpolatedComponent
functions.docs:
Assigns the component that will be used for network interpolation/smoothing. It is expected that this is a component attached somewhere below the UpdatedComponent.
When network updates use MoveInterpolationTarget() to move the UpdatedComponent, the interpolated component's relative offset will be maintained and smoothed over
the course of future component ticks. The current relative location and rotation of the component is saved as the target offset for future interpolation.
@see MoveInterpolationTarget(), bInterpMovement, bInterpRotation

functions.name: MoveInterpolationTarget
functions.docs:
Moves the UpdatedComponent, which is also the interpolation target for the interpolated component. If there is not interpolated component, this simply moves UpdatedComponent.
Use this typically from PostNetReceiveLocationAndRotation() or similar from an Actor.

functions.name: ResetInterpolation
functions.docs: Resets interpolation so that interpolated component snaps back to the initial location/rotation without any additional offsets.

functions.name: IsInterpolationComplete
functions.docs: Returns whether interpolation is complete because the target has been reached. True when interpolation is disabled.

functions.name: LimitVelocity
functions.docs: Don't allow velocity magnitude to exceed MaxSpeed, if MaxSpeed is non-zero.
